items.definition:
consistently good in quality or performance; able to be trusted
She is a very reliable employee.

worthy of attention; striking
She made remarkable progress in her studies.

only; single
His sole purpose was to help others.

deserving respect or attention
Her efforts were worthy of praise.

covered in blood; (UK informal) used to express anger or to emphasize a statement
He had a bloody nose after the fall.

extremely important; vital
It is crucial that we act immediately.

consisting of two parts, elements, or aspects
He holds dual citizenship.

based on or derived from experience rather than theory; new or innovative
They are conducting experimental research on new drugs.

fully developed physically; behaving in a sensible way like an adult
She is very mature for her age.

average; not extreme
The weather forecast predicts moderate winds for tomorrow.

side by side and having the same distance continuously between them
The two roads run parallel to each other for several miles.

extremely impressive or attractive
The view from the mountain top was absolutely stunning.

relating to ancient Greek or Latin literature, art, or culture; traditional
She enjoys listening to classical music, especially Mozart.

relating to government revenue, especially taxes
The government announced new fiscal policies.

(of a feeling or action) experienced or done by each of two or more parties toward the other or others
They had a mutual respect for each other.

relating to the mouth; spoken rather than written
The students had an oral exam.

large or important
They made considerable progress on the project.

based on or in accordance with what is generally accepted
She prefers conventional methods of teaching.

not natural
The flowers were beautiful, but they were artificial.

varied
The city has a diverse population.

working, practical
The new software is fully functional.

relating to a city or town
The municipal government handles local services.

relating to a navy or ships
The country has a strong naval force.

having high moral principles
He made a noble effort to help the poor.

holy or deserving respect
The temple is a sacred place for many people.

poisonous or harmful
Be careful, that plant is toxic.

causing public disagreement
The new policy is highly controversial.

most important, powerful, or influential
The company holds a dominant position in the market.

relating to visual art; vivid
The movie contained graphic violence.

very famous or well known
He is a legendary figure in the music industry.

sequential
The police are looking for a serial killer.

conforming to the law or rules; valid
That's a legitimate question that deserves an answer.

achieving a significant amount or result
It was a very productive meeting; we made a lot of progress.

small in degree; inconsiderable
There was a slight delay due to traffic.

ongoing, uninterrupted
The rain was continuous for three days.

exactly alike
The two cars were identical.

in working order; ready for use
The new system is fully operational now.

exposed to the possibility of being attacked or harmed
Young children are especially vulnerable to illness.

(of an illness or problem) persisting for a long time or constantly recurring
He suffers from chronic back pain.

relating to the coast
The coastal towns are popular tourist destinations.

able to be maintained
We need to find sustainable energy solutions.

found or distributed over a large area
There is widespread support for the new policy.

able to be reached or entered
The building is accessible to wheelchair users.

aware of and responding to one's surroundings
He was conscious of the eyes watching him.

relating to a large city
New York is a large metropolitan area.

relating to structure
The engineers checked the structural integrity of the bridge.

of high quality and lasting value, or relating to a past era
She loves collecting vintage clothing.

not identified by name
The donation was made by an anonymous donor.

dearly loved
He returned to his beloved hometown.

relating to a colony
Many countries have a colonial past.

opposite in nature, direction, or meaning
On the contrary, I think it's a good idea.

having the properties of a magnet; able to attract iron or steel
The refrigerator door has a magnetic seal.

existing only in part; incomplete
The report gave only a partial explanation of the events.

endless; limitless
The universe seems to be infinite.

sensible; practical
We need to set realistic goals.

relating to the human voice
She has a very strong vocal performance.

existing in thought or as an idea but not having a physical or concrete existence
His paintings are very abstract and open to interpretation.

dishonest or immoral
The corrupt official was arrested for bribery.

severe or cruel; unpleasantly rough
The desert climate can be very harsh.

protected from a disease or obligation
After vaccination, she became immune to the virus.

according to the rules of logic or formal argument
His argument was very logical and convincing.

having a serious, important, or useful quality or purpose
They had a meaningful conversation about their future.

Syrian
The Syrian conflict has displaced millions.

applicable
This rule is not applicable in your case.
